scope: Four existing claim clusters: primary facsimile where available, otherwise explicit historic/source-report limits; no generalization to customs identity.
normative_legal_guard: 1967 Indulgentiarum doctrina and 1999 Enchiridion apply independently; old privileges are not assumed present; post-1967 particular grants require their precise own conditions and status.

cases.title: St Joseph first Wednesday devotion
cases.finding: Oblates of St Joseph history reports indulgences granted in 1921 at request of Sisters of St Joseph of Philadelphia, augmented in 1933. This is not the primary decree or a proof of present applicability.
cases.scope_boundaries: special St Joseph devotion on the first Wednesday, not all St Joseph customs or all Wednesdays
cases.next_step: Retrieve 1921 and 1933 Apostolic Penitentiary or Raccolta rescripts, exact prayers/acts, eligible persons, temporal conditions and subsequent revision.

cases.title: Breton pardons
cases.finding: French cultural heritage inventory distinguishes medieval pardons with papal indulgence bulls from later patronal festivals called pardons even without a bull; there is no universal grant attached to the name.
cases.scope_boundaries: named chapel, date and work; majority of local chapels historically had no such grant according to inventory
cases.next_step: Choose a named chapel and recover its actual papal bull or diocesan published concession with prescribed work and dates; do not apply universally.

cases.title: Caravaca Vera Cruz Sanctuary
cases.finding: 1998 signed Apostolic Penitentiary Latin concession (Prot. N. 2/98/I) reproduced as a facsimile with English translation on page 5 (zero-based PDF page 4) of a Murcia regional-government religious-tourism brochure. Diocese of Cartagena and shrine confraternity confirm listed works and continuing concession. This is a specific indulgenced work, not every Caravaca festival or object.
cases.issuer: Apostolic Penitentiary, by mandate of the Supreme Pontiff
historical_qualifying_occasions: 14 September Exaltation of Cross at sanctuary
once yearly on personally selected day
solemn jubilee opening/closing every seven years
solemn jubilee-year liturgy presided over by diocesan bishop
cases.historical_prescribed_work: Devout participation in a celebration at the Sanctuary of the Santísima y Vera Cruz of Caravaca or at least Our Father or Creed, with proper visit; consult original wording
historical_conditions: prayer for intentions of Supreme Pontiff
cases.scope_boundaries: sanctuary-specific; no automatic qualification by ownership of a Caravaca cross or attendance at unrelated customs; do not confuse pilgrimage with tourism
cases.next_step: Check Latin scan against translation; confirm the current diocesan instructions and no superseding rescript; editorial signoff for the exact act/occasion/conditions before Calendar display.

cases.title: Maria Thalkirchen Frauendreißiger
cases.finding: Shrine website reports that Pius VI granted a plenary indulgence in 1780 and describes pilgrimage, devotion, confession, Mass and prayer for the Pope. It describes observance during 15 August–14 September. Original 1780 instrument not retrieved; post-1967 continuity cannot be inferred solely from an 18th-century privilege.
cases.scope_boundaries: Maria Thalkirchen local pilgrimage in Frauendreißiger, not the Marian season universally
cases.next_step: Obtain 1780 Pius VI text and local ordinariate's current promulgation/confirmation; date range, qualifying acts and current status require authoritative reconciliation.
